info.name: VCX: accounts
info.description: The accounts microservice, called on its own address. accountsUrl is the relay the start command opens in front of it: the service speaks HTTP/2 in cleartext, which Postman and Newman cannot send, and the relay carries each request to it over HTTP/2. The Tokens folder fills accessToken (Alice), adminToken and bobToken; internalToken comes from the environment. Each family folder holds the requests of that family's scenarios, with a reset where a scenario changes the store.
